bng.text: Tynthal is the city where Aesrias delivers harpy heads to Governor Pilun in the civic temple, only to be falsely accused of stealing from a merchant, and, tired and suspecting a plot, he lets himself be shackled.
In a coliseum holding pen he realizes he is meant for illegal arena killing, and a star-skinned nyxborn blesses him with Iroas's power.
Wax-deafened to the songs of nine chained sirens, Aesrias kills several of them with their own chains, and the remaining four carry him out of the coliseum and into the countryside.
